faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About IVF & Fertility Treatment

items.question: What is IVF and how does it work?
items.answer: IVF (in-vitro fertilisation) is a fertility treatment where eggs are collected from the ovaries and fertilised with sperm in our embryology lab. The resulting embryo is cultured for a few days and then transferred into the uterus. At Alchemy IVF in Kathmandu, every IVF cycle is tailored to your diagnosis to give you the best possible chance of pregnancy.

items.question: Which fertility conditions does Alchemy IVF treat?
items.answer: We treat the full range of male and female infertility, including blocked fallopian tubes, PCOS, endometriosis, low ovarian reserve, low sperm count or motility, recurrent pregnancy loss and unexplained infertility. After a thorough evaluation, our specialists recommend the most effective treatment — IVF, IUI, ICSI or a donor program.

items.question: How long does one IVF cycle take?
items.answer: A typical IVF cycle takes about four to six weeks from the start of ovarian stimulation to embryo transfer. If we recommend a frozen embryo transfer, that may be scheduled in a later cycle. We share a clear, week-by-week timeline at your first consultation.

items.question: What is the IVF success rate at your clinic in Nepal?
items.answer: IVF success rates depend on age, diagnosis, egg and sperm quality, and the treatment plan. Rather than quote a single number, our doctors share realistic, clinic-specific success rates for couples with a profile similar to yours during your consultation — so you can make an informed decision.

items.question: What is the difference between IVF, IUI and ICSI?
items.answer: IUI (intrauterine insemination) places prepared sperm directly into the uterus and is a gentle first-line treatment. IVF fertilises eggs and sperm in the lab before transferring an embryo. ICSI is a specialised form of IVF where a single healthy sperm is injected directly into each egg — ideal for severe male-factor infertility. Our specialists help you choose the right option.

items.question: How much does IVF cost in Kathmandu?
items.answer: We believe in transparent, upfront pricing. The final cost of IVF depends on your medication, the number of cycles and any add-ons such as ICSI or PGT-A genetic testing. Our team provides a clear, written estimate before you commit — with no hidden charges.

items.question: Do you offer donor eggs, donor sperm and fertility preservation?
items.answer: Yes. We run a fully screened donor egg, donor sperm and donor embryo program with thorough medical, genetic and infectious-disease testing. We also offer fertility preservation — egg, sperm and embryo freezing — including fast-track options for patients before cancer treatment.

items.question: Do you support international and out-of-town patients?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our medical tourism desk assists patients travelling to Kathmandu with visa support letters, airport pickup, hotel bookings and remote follow-up consultations, so your fertility treatment is as smooth and stress-free as possible.
